#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

using ll = long long;
const ll INF = (ll)1e18;
const int MAXV = 6000;

struct Edge {
    ll nxt, cap, cost, rev;
};

vector<Edge> graph[MAXV];
ll dist[MAXV];
ll preNode[MAXV], preEdge[MAXV];
bool inqueue[MAXV];
int nodeCount, source, sink;

void initialize(int n, int s, int t) {
    for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) graph[i].clear();
    nodeCount = n;
    source = s;
    sink = t;
}

void add_edge(int u, int v, ll capacity, ll weight) {
    graph[u].push_back({v, capacity, weight, (ll)graph[v].size()});
    graph[v].push_back({u, 0, -weight, (ll)graph[u].size() - 1});
}

ll min_cost_flow(ll flowLimit) {
    ll answer = 0;
    while (flowLimit > 0) {
        fill(dist, dist + nodeCount, INF);
        dist[source] = 0;
        queue<int> q;
        q.push(source);
        inqueue[source] = true;
        while (!q.empty()) {
            int u = q.front(); q.pop();
            inqueue[u] = false;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)graph[u].size(); ++i) {
                Edge &e = graph[u][i];
                if (e.cap > 0 && dist[u] + e.cost < dist[e.nxt]) {
                    dist[e.nxt] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                    preNode[e.nxt] = u;
                    preEdge[e.nxt] = i;
                    if (!inqueue[e.nxt]) {
                        inqueue[e.nxt] = true;
                        q.push(e.nxt);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[sink] == INF) return -1;
        ll pushed = flowLimit;
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = preNode[v])
            pushed = min(pushed, graph[preNode[v]][preEdge[v]].cap);
        flowLimit -= pushed;
        answer += pushed * dist[sink];
        for (int v = sink; v != source; v = preNode[v]) {
            Edge &e = graph[preNode[v]][preEdge[v]];
            e.cap -= pushed;
            graph[v][e.rev].cap += pushed;
        }
    }
    return answer;
}

ll N, M, K, C, D;
ll A[58];
vector<int> H[57];

int32_t main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(0);
    cin.tie(0);
    cout.tie(0);
    cin >> N >> M >> K >> C >> D;
    for (ll i = 1; i <= K; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        A[x]++;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= M; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        H[x].push_back(y);
        H[y].push_back(x);
    }

    initialize(5103, 0, 5101);
    for (int i = 2; i <= N; ++i) add_edge(0, i, A[i], 0);
    for (int i = 0; i <= 100; ++i) {
        for (int l = 1; l <= N; ++l) {
            add_edge(50 * i + l, 50 * (i + 1) + l, K, 0);
            for (int j : H[l]) {
                for (ll k = 1; k <= K; ++k) {
                    add_edge(50 * i + l, 50 * (i + 1) + j, 1, D * (2 * k - 1));
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= 101; ++i) add_edge(50 * i + 1, 5101, K, C * i);
    cout << min_cost_flow(K) << endl;
}
